question: What is polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)?
answer: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is defined by a clinical triad of anovulation, insulin resistance, and androgen excess. It has an estimated prevalence of 5%–10% in women of reproductive age.
